items.hed: The Houston Texans dominated the Indianapolis Colts 26-3 on Thursday Night Football at NRG Stadium behind three C.J. Stroud touchdown passes, and now have an extended break before their next game, a Week 12 home matchup against the Baltimore Ravens on Sunday, Nov. 29
items.insight: Stroud threw for 194 yards and three touchdowns — to Nico Collins, Kayson Boutte and Marlin Klein — as Houston built an early lead and never trailed, with defensive end Logan Hall blocking a 62-yard field goal try and the defense holding Indianapolis without a touchdown for the first time since 2024. The Texans' own schedule page confirms there is no game this weekend; the short week after Thursday's win is followed by a 10-day break before the team hosts Baltimore at Reliant Stadium (formerly NRG Stadium) in Week 12, with full broadcast and streaming information carried on the team's own site.
items.image_caption: NRG Stadium (formerly Reliant Stadium), Houston. Venue still.

items.hed: New Astros general manager Randy Flores reshaped Houston's outfield this week, outrighting Joey Loperfido to Triple-A and non-tendering Taylor Trammell ahead of Friday's non-tender deadline, after the unit posted the majors' 29th-ranked .662 OPS last season
items.insight: The team's own site reports Flores, in one of his first major roster moves, outrighted Loperfido to Triple-A Sugar Land on Nov. 17 while adding right-hander Jackson Nezuh to the 40-man roster to protect him from the Rule 5 Draft, then non-tendered outfielder Taylor Trammell ahead of the league-wide non-tender deadline. The moves follow Flores and new manager Brad Ausmus filling out the front office and coaching staff this month, including hiring Bobby Wilson as bench coach and Matt Bayer as an assistant general manager, as Houston works through an offseason overhaul aimed at fixing the outfield production that lagged the rest of the roster in 2026.

items.hed: The Houston Rockets fell to the Denver Nuggets 133-124 in Denver on Friday night in Emirates NBA Cup West Group A play, a rematch loss after Houston had beaten Denver earlier this month
items.insight: The Rockets dropped Friday's game at Ball Arena after winning the season's earlier meeting between the two teams, splitting the season series ahead of any further Cup or regular-season matchups, according to the league's own box-score pages. The loss counts in both NBA Cup West Group A standings and the regular-season column. No fresher Rockets game result had posted on the league's own schedule and news pages as of this afternoon; the Rockets' next games are available on the NBA's official schedule page, with Texas viewers encouraged to check the league's own broadcast listing rather than unofficial streams.
